labels.title: Add a label
labels.description: Labels allow to create aliases inside mx_hal_def.h file like '<label>_init', '<label>_deinit' and '<label>_gethandle'. These aliases can be used on application side.

actions.message: Name must be a valid C identifier: start with a letter or underscore, and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.

init_type.title: Resource initialization code generation
init_type.description: Pick whether the initialization code should be generated and automatically called at startup.

oneOf.title: Callable
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated and called in peripheral initialization.

oneOf.title: Generated
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated but not called in peripheral initialization.

rw_recovery_time_cycle.title: Recovery time
rw_recovery_time_cycle.description: Number of cycles for the device recovery time.

access_time_cycle.title: Access time
access_time_cycle.description: Number of cycles for the device access time.

size_bit.title: Size
size_bit.description: Maximum size of the memory that you are using.

cs_boundary.title: Chip select boundary
cs_boundary.description: Granularity at which the chip select signal can be toggled.

cs_high_time_cycle.title: Chip select high time
cs_high_time_cycle.description: Minimum number of clock cycles during which the chip select must remain high between commands.

cs_refresh_time.title: Chip select refresh time
cs_refresh_time.description: Refresh rate feature. Choose the number of clock cycles after which the chip select signal will be released periodically. Applicable for RAM only.

cs_refresh_time_converted.title: Chip select refresh time conversion
cs_refresh_time_converted.description: This feature is applicable to RAM memory only.

wrap_size_byte.title: Wrap size
wrap_size_byte.description: Wrap size if wrapped reads are supported by the memory.

clock_source.title: Clock source
clock_source.description: Clock source can be modified in clock tree.

clock_source_frequency.title: Clock source frequency
clock_source_frequency.description: Input clock frequency can be modified in clock tree.

clk_prescaler.title: Clock prescaler (value +1)
clk_prescaler.description: This prescaler divides the kernel clock source frequency to get the final frequency on XSPI bus. Choosing a prescaler value of N means dividing the clock by N+1.

clock_memory_frequency.title: Clock memory frequency
clock_memory_frequency.description: Clock frequency on XSPI bus. This is the frequency at which the memory will operate. It is equal to the input clock frequency divided by the clock prescaler.

shift.title: Sample shifting
shift.description: The sample of data is taken a full clock cycle after the data is driven by the external device, instead of half a clock cycle (default value). Applicable in SDR (single data rate) communication only.

hold.title: Delay hold quarter cycle
hold.description: Add a quarter delay on the outputs in DTR (double-transfer rate) communication to match hold requirement. Applicable in DTR communication only.

set_fifo_threshold.title: FIFO threshold
set_fifo_threshold.description: Choose the number of bytes in the FIFO that causes the FIFO threshold flag to be set.

cssel.title: NCS select
cssel.description: Select if NCS is copied to NCS1 or NCS2.

clock_polarity.title: Clock polarity
clock_polarity.description: Level of clock signal when clock is in IDLE state (when chip is not selected).

dlyb_state.title: Enable delay block
dlyb_state.description: Delay block peripheral dedicated to your XSPI instance.

oneOf.title: Sampling clock delayed
oneOf.description: Sampling clock is delayed by the delay block.

auto_evaluate_delay.title: Automatic evaluation of delay block output clock phase
auto_evaluate_delay.description: Generates code to automatically evaluate and set the output clock phase value of the delay block peripheral.

actions.message: You must enable delay block to use this feature.

set_config_delay.title: Manual set of delay block output clock phase
set_config_delay.description: If you already know the delay block output clock phase value, choose the value you want to set. Available only if  delay block is enable and automatic evaluation is disabled.

delay_value_type.title: Calibration type
delay_value_type.description: Select which calibration is concerned by the configuration. Manual HSIC configuration must be enabled to configure this parameter.

oneOf.title: Full clock cycle
oneOf.description: Delay value equivalent to full memory-clock cycle.

oneOf.title: Feedback clock
oneOf.description: Delay value for the feedback clock when reading without DQS.

oneOf.title: Output data
oneOf.description: Delay value for output data in DDR mode for write operations.

oneOf.title: DQS input
oneOf.description: Delay value for DQS input when sampling data for read operations.

fine_cal_unit.title: Fine calibration value
fine_cal_unit.description: Fine calibration value of the delay. Manual HSIC configuration must be enabled to configure this parameter.

coarse_cal_unit.title: Coarse calibration value
coarse_cal_unit.description: Coarse calibration value of the delay. Manual HSIC configuration must be enabled to configure this parameter.

max_cal.title: Outside range calibration
max_cal.description: Memory-clock period is inside or outside the range of DLL master. Manual HSIC configuration must be enabled to configure this parameter.

mode.title: Dual memory mode
mode.description: Enable dual memory mode to manage two memories connected in parallel on the same XSPI interface.

cs_release_time_cycle.title: Maximum bytes transfer
cs_release_time_cycle.description: Communication regulation feature. Choose the maximum number of bytes to transfer before the other XSPI request the access to the bus (chip select release time).

security_privilege.title: Security and privilege
security_privilege.description: Manage security and privileged access levels attributes.

security.title: Security attribute
security.description: Set the security attribute of the securable peripheral.

actions.message: The security attribute of the peripheral is automatically set to secure when the peripheral is bound to a secure resource and to non-secure when it is not. Manual configuration is not allowed.

privilege.title: Privileged attribute
privilege.description: Manage the privileged attribute of a securable RISC peripheral.

lock.title: Lock
lock.description: Optional. Lock security and privilege attributes to prevent changes.

actions.message: Secure-only mode: Illegal access interrupt is forced to disabled.

pin_selection.title: Pins selection
pin_selection.description: Pins selection is managed in XSPIM/OCTOSPIM panel. A dedicated IO Manager is used to configure the GPIOs for this instance.
